summary: Correctness and architecture review found one critical bug (normalizeJobRow missing reviewId/payloadJson) which was fixed. All other probes pass. Tests green, type-check green, build green.

findings.title: normalizeJobRow missing reviewId and payloadJson fields
findings.description: The normalizeJobRow function (used by claimDueJobs via raw SQL RETURNING *) did NOT extract review_id or payload_json from the SQL result rows. When the worker claimed a job, processJob received a ReviewJob with reviewId=undefined. This caused: (1) updatePrReview was never called on success — the review row stayed 'pending' forever; (2) completeApprovedPrReviewLesson was never called; (3) payloadJson was lost so re-runs couldn't access the original webhook payload.
findings.fix_description: Added reviewId and payloadJson extraction to normalizeJobRow. Added both fields to ReviewJob interface. Updated enqueueReviewJob return values (both fast-path and durable-path). Simplified processJob signature from ReviewJob & {reviewId, payloadJson} to ReviewJob. Updated runWorkerTick cast.

findings.title: Pervasive 'any' types in review-worker.ts for DB connections
findings.description: Multiple 'any' casts for DB connections (privilegedDb, claimDueJobs, reclaimStuckJobs, processJob deps, applySettle, runWorkerTick). The DB type from @reading-advantage/db exists but is not used. Consistent with codebase-wide patterns where DB is loosely typed for mock flexibility.
findings.fix_description: Not fixed — codebase-wide pattern. Would require significant refactoring of DB typing across the project.

findings.title: Missing JSDoc on some exported interfaces
findings.description: AGENTS.md requires JSDoc on every exported interface. EnqueueReviewJobInput, ClaimDueJobsOptions, ProcessJobDeps, SettleJobOptions, SettleJobPayload, CreateReviewWorkerOptions, ReviewWorker lack top-level JSDoc (though many have field-level comments). All exported functions have JSDoc.
findings.fix_description: Not fixed — documentation gap, not a correctness issue.
